in_marathi.long_meaning: Deepjyoti हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Deepjyoti is a name derived from Sanskrit, meaning 'deep' and 'light'. This name represents the enlightened soul that seeks to bring light and knowledge to the world. In Hindu mythology, Deepjyoti is a name associated with the god Vishnu, who is known as the preserver of the universe and the giver of knowledge.
